overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 58.13% annualised against 22.84% volatility (Sharpe 1.92) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 36.3%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.37% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 2.87% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -13.07%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.
